Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.description: Find answers to common questions about {brand}. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team.

trial.question: How does the free trial work?
trial.answer: Our free trial gives you full access to all features for 14 days. No credit card required. At the end of the trial, you can choose the plan that best suits your needs or continue with the free plan with limited features.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. If you upgrade, the new rate will be charged immediately. If you downgrade, the new rate will be applied at the next billing cycle.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We also support payment via PayPal and bank transfers for annual enterprise plans.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes, we take security very seriously. All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest. We use industry-standard security practices and regularly undergo security audits to ensure your data is protected.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. Once canceled, you'll still have access to your plan until the end of your current billing period.

discounts.question: Do you offer discounts for non-profits or educational institutions?
discounts.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for non-profit organizations, educational institutions, and startups. Please contact our sales team for more information.
